description: The skills a monitor can carry on this account: extra checks run on every check, each with its own alert rules (speed and Core Web Vitals, SEO, accessibility, broken links, security signals, page problems, third-party scripts, cookies and trackers, SSL certificate and domain expiry). Each entry gives the name for create_monitor/update_monitor `skills`, the rule ids, units, defaults and ranges for `skillAlerts`, its options, and `locked` when the plan does not include it.
name: list_skills
title: List monitoring skills
